key_structures: 14 majestic Gopurams (tallest southern gopuram at 52 meters)
special_features: Enchanting emerald-hued green stone murti of Meenakshi holding a lotus and companion parrot
Musical pillars carved from single granite stones producing distinct swaras
Astounding ceiling frescoes depicting 64 divine leelas of Lord Shiva
materials: Fine stucco and lime plaster for thousands of gopuram sculptures
renovation_history: Pandyas established the ancient shrine; after 14th-century disruptions, magnificently rebuilt and expanded to present cosmic layout by Nayaka dynasty rulers, especially Thirumalai Nayak.
